brief:
Majed Faraj, head of the Palestinian General Intelligence Service, has called on Hamas to apologize to the Palestinian people over events of October 7 during the "Al-Aqsa Flood" operation, Shehab Wire reported. Faraj's remarks come at a significant moment, though the full context of his timing remains unclear from available information.

The operation, which Hamas carried out on that date, has become a central point of Palestinian political debate and division. Faraj's public call for an apology represents a sharp divergence within Palestinian leadership over the military action and its consequences.
